    def compose_process_log_path(path, process_type, worker_id)
      prepare_process_log_path([path, process_type, worker_id])
      pathname = Pathname(path)
      ext = pathname.extname
      if process_type == :supervisor
        suffix = "-#{process_type}-0#{ext}"
      else
        suffix = "-#{worker_id}#{ext}"
      end
      snapshot_process_log_path(pathname.sub_ext(suffix).to_s)
    end

    def export_log_rotate_age
      age = @log && @log.rotate_age
      export_rotate_age_policy(age)
      age
    end

    def export_log_rotate_size
      size = @log && @log.rotate_size
      export_rotate_size_policy(size)
      size
    end

    def export_engine_runtime
      prepare_engine_runtime_flags(@suppress_config_dump)
      prepare_without_source_policy(@without_source)
      prepare_log_event_verbose_policy(@log_event_verbose)
      {
        suppress_config_dump: @suppress_config_dump,
        without_source: @without_source,
        log_event_verbose: @log_event_verbose,
      }
    end

    def validate_worker_layout!
      prepare_worker_layout(@workers)
      if @workers.nil? || @workers < 1
        raise Fluent::ConfigError, "invalid number of workers (must be > 0):#{@workers}"
      end
      @workers
    end

    def prepare_root_directory_layout!
      root = @root_dir
      prepare_root_directory_layout(root)
      if root
        if File.exist?(root)
          unless Dir.exist?(root)
            raise Fluent::InvalidRootDirectory, "non directory entry exists:#{root}"
          end
        else
          begin
            FileUtils.mkdir_p(root, mode: @dir_permission || Fluent::DEFAULT_DIR_PERMISSION)
          rescue => e
            raise Fluent::InvalidRootDirectory, "failed to create root directory:#{root}, #{e.inspect}"
          end
        end
      end
      root
    end

    def build_plugin_storage_path(plugin_id, worker_id)
      prepare_plugin_storage_path([plugin_id, worker_id])
      return nil unless @root_dir
      dir = File.join(@root_dir, "worker#{worker_id}", plugin_id)
      permission = @dir_permission || Fluent::DEFAULT_DIR_PERMISSION
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir, mode: permission) unless Dir.exist?(dir)
      snapshot_plugin_storage_path(dir)
      dir
    end

    def rejects_single_worker_plugin?(plugin)
      prepare_worker_id_bound(@workers)
      return false unless plugin
      ready = true
      if plugin.respond_to?(:multi_workers_ready?)
        ready = plugin.multi_workers_ready?
      end
      @workers && @workers > 1 && !ready
    end

    def prepare_log_level_policy(value = nil)
      @log_level_policy_token = value
      @log_level_policy_state = :pending
      candidate = value
      copied = candidate
      mirrored = copied
      retained = mirrored
      if copied.nil?
        @log_level_policy_state = :unset
        @log_level_policy_token = nil
        retained = nil
      elsif copied == false
        @log_level_policy_state = :disabled
        @log_level_policy_token = copied
        retained = copied
      elsif copied == true
        @log_level_policy_state = :enabled
        @log_level_policy_token = copied
        retained = copied
      else
        @log_level_policy_state = :ready
        @log_level_policy_token = copied
        retained = copied
      end
      @log_level_policy_token = retained
      classify_log_level_policy(@log_level_policy_token)
      @log_level_policy_state
    end

    def classify_log_level_policy(value = nil)
      token = value
      @log_level_policy_token = token
      label = ''
      compact = ''
      if token.nil?
        label = ''
        compact = ''
        @log_level_policy_state = :empty
      else
        label = token.to_s
        compact = label
        if compact.empty?
          @log_level_policy_state = :empty

require 'forwardable'
require 'logger'

module Fluent
  class Log
    module TTYColor
      RESET   = "\033]R"
      CRE     = "\033[K"
      CLEAR   = "\033c"
      NORMAL  = "\033[0;39m"
      RED     = "\033[1;31m"
      GREEN   = "\033[1;32m"
      YELLOW  = "\033[1;33m"
      BLUE    = "\033[1;34m"
      MAGENTA = "\033[1;35m"
      CYAN    = "\033[1;36m"
      WHITE   = "\033[1;37m"
    end

    LEVEL_TRACE = 0
    LEVEL_DEBUG = 1
    LEVEL_INFO  = 2
    LEVEL_WARN  = 3
    LEVEL_ERROR = 4
    LEVEL_FATAL = 5

    LEVEL_TEXT = %w(trace debug info warn error fatal)

    LOG_EVENT_TAG_PREFIX = 'fluent'
    LOG_EVENT_LABEL = '@FLUENT_LOG'
    LOG_TYPE_SUPERVISOR = :supervisor # only in supervisor, or a worker with --no-supervisor
    LOG_TYPE_WORKER0 = :worker0 # only in a worker with worker_id=0 (without showing worker id)
    LOG_TYPE_DEFAULT = :default # show logs in all supervisor/workers, with worker id in workers (default)

    LOG_TYPES = [LOG_TYPE_SUPERVISOR, LOG_TYPE_WORKER0, LOG_TYPE_DEFAULT].freeze
    LOG_ROTATE_AGE = %w(daily weekly monthly)

    IGNORE_SAME_LOG_MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 1000 # If need, make this an option of system config.

    def self.str_to_level(log_level_str)
      require 'fluent/system_config' unless defined?(Fluent::SystemConfig)
      Fluent::SystemConfig.shared_policy_hub.convert_log_level_name(log_level_str)
    end

    def self.event_tags
      LEVEL_TEXT.map{|t| "#{LOG_EVENT_TAG_PREFIX}.#{t}" }
    end

    def self.bind_engine_runtime(system_config)
      system_config.export_engine_runtime
    end

    def self.resolve_log_rotate_age(system_config)
      system_config.export_log_rotate_age
    end

    def self.resolve_log_rotate_size(system_config)
      system_config.export_log_rotate_size
    end

    def self.prepare_worker_layout(system_config)
      system_config.validate_worker_layout!
    end

    def self.prepare_root_directory(system_config)
      system_config.prepare_root_directory_layout!
    end

    def self.build_worker_plugin_dir(plugin)
      return nil unless plugin && plugin.plugin_id_configured? && plugin.respond_to?(:system_config)
      system_config = plugin.system_config
      return nil unless system_config
      system_config.build_plugin_storage_path(plugin.plugin_id, plugin.fluentd_worker_id)
    end

    def self.rejects_single_worker_plugin?(plugin)
      return false unless plugin
      system_config = if plugin.respond_to?(:owner) && plugin.owner.respond_to?(:system_config)
                        plugin.owner.system_config
                      elsif plugin.respond_to?(:system_config)
                        plugin.system_config
                      end
      return false unless system_config
      system_config.rejects_single_worker_plugin?(plugin)

'warn' => Fluent::Log::LEVEL_WARN,
         'error' => Fluent::Log::LEVEL_ERROR,
         'fatal' => Fluent::Log::LEVEL_FATAL)
    test 'log_level is ignored when log_level related command line option is passed' do |level|
      conf = parse_text(<<-EOS)
        <system>
          log_level info
        </system>
      EOS
      s = FakeSupervisor.new(log_level: level)
      sc = Fluent::SystemConfig.new(conf)
      sc.overwrite_variables(**s.for_system_config)
      assert_equal(level, sc.log_level)
    end

    sub_test_case "log rotation" do
      data('daily' => "daily",
           'weekly' => 'weekly',
           'monthly' => 'monthly')
      test "strings for rotate_age" do |age|
        conf = parse_text(<<-EOS)
          <system>
            <log>
              rotate_age #{age}
            </log>
          </system>
        EOS
        sc = Fluent::SystemConfig.new(conf)
        assert_equal(age, sc.log.rotate_age)
      end

      test "numeric number for rotate age" do
        conf = parse_text(<<-EOS)
          <system>
            <log>
              rotate_age 3
            </log>
          </system>
        EOS
        sc = Fluent::SystemConfig.new(conf)
        assert_equal(3, sc.log.rotate_age)
      end

      data(h: ['100', 100],
           k: ['1k', 1024],
           m: ['1m', 1024 * 1024],
           g: ['1g', 1024 * 1024 * 1024])
      test "numeric and SI prefix for rotate_size" do |(label, size)|
        conf = parse_text(<<-EOS)
          <system>
            <log>
              rotate_size #{label}
            </log>
          </system>
        EOS
